# clavis secrets generate

<p class="cli-lead">Generate a random value and store it</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis secrets generate KEY [flags]
```

</div>

Generate a random value and store it, without the value ever passing through your clipboard.

## Examples

```sh
clavis secrets generate SESSION_KEY --type password --length 48
clavis secrets generate RELEASE_ID --type uuid
```

## Flags

<dl class="cli-flags">
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-kind"><dt><code>--kind string</code></dt><dd>secret, variable, or file <span class="cli-default">Default: <code>secret</code></span></dd></div>
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-length"><dt><code>--length int</code></dt><dd>length for password/apikey/hex/base64 types <span class="cli-default">Default: <code>32</code></span></dd></div>

<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-yes"><dt><code>--yes</code></dt><dd>skip production confirmation</dd></div>
</dl>
